title: Extension core object section still documents removed feature
reality: v2.3.4 removed the extension feature completely: all extension CSS/browser/server payload execution is gone, the Settings surface, client hooks, shared contract, and API routes were deleted, and the authoring guides and Professor Mari instructions were removed with it. The scoped `marinara` client API no longer exists.
fix: Delete the '### Extension' section under The Core Objects, including the 'See references/extensions.md' pointer, and add a note that the extension feature was fully removed in v2.3.4 and startup erases retained extension records.

title: Big Picture diagram lists Extensions in the client
reality: v2.3.4 deleted the extension Settings surface, client hooks, and API routes; the client no longer has an Extensions surface.
fix: In the Big Picture ASCII diagram, remove '- Extensions' from the client feature list.

title: Data Storage list still includes extensions
reality: v2.3.4 startup permanently erases every retained server-side extension record and all extension-storage:* settings, and the UI-state migration removes browser-local extension records automatically; extensions are no longer stored data.
fix: In Data Storage, change 'themes, extensions' to 'themes' and note that v2.3.4 startup purges legacy extension records and extension-storage:* settings.

title: What's NOT Built-In says CSS/JS extensions remain manual installs
reality: There is no extension mechanism at all in v2.3.4 — CSS/JS extensions cannot be installed manually or otherwise; payload execution paths were deleted.
fix: Rewrite the bullet: official capability packages install from Download Agents; client CSS/JS extensions were removed entirely in v2.3.4 (customization beyond themes now requires forking).

title: Conversation group turns described as single merged generation only
reality: #3887 (v2.3.4) added Grouped AND Individual response modes to multi-character Conversations, with sequential, smart, manual, mention-directed, and autonomous character selection, a shared daily check-in budget, and a token-use warning. Supersedes the v2.3.1 'single merged provider generation per group turn' description (#3609). #3891 made mentions always select the mentioned responder(s) and removed the Reply When Mentioned toggle.
fix: Rewrite the Group DMs paragraph: describe Grouped vs Individual response modes, the five selection strategies, the shared daily check-in budget and token-use warning (#3887), and always-on mention selection (#3891). Keep the merged-bubble split-per-speaker display note as Grouped-mode behavior.

title: Cross-chat awareness described as hardcoded <awareness> XML
reality: #3753 (v2.3.4): recalled memories, cross-chat awareness, connected Roleplay/Game context, and their command instructions now honor the active Conversation preset's XML, Markdown, or unwrapped format instead of emitting hardcoded XML. #3889 consolidated Cross-Chat Awareness under Connected Chats in the UI.
fix: Update the cross-chat awareness bullet ('injects them in the active preset's XML/Markdown/unwrapped format, #3753'); update the Connected chats bullet similarly for the <influence>/<ooc> framing, and note the Connected Chats consolidation (#3889).

title: No mention of verbatim prompt leaf content
reality: v2.3.4 stopped HTML-escaping angle brackets in prompt leaf content: character card fields, persona, lorebook entries, memories, and scene text reach the model verbatim. Supersedes the #3108 prompt-boundary escaping and the hardened-prompt-assembly untrusted-card-text escaping; framework structural wrappers and agent value/attribute escapers are unchanged.
fix: Add a v2.3.4 note to Prompt Assembly: leaf content is passed verbatim with no HTML-escaping of angle brackets; only structural section wrappers and machine-parsed agent XML values are still escaped.

title: ComfyUI listed as image-gen only; video provider list omits ComfyUI
reality: #3804 (v2.3.4) added local ComfyUI VIDEO generation for API-format WAN and other workflows, with prompt, size, seed, frame-count, and uploaded first-frame placeholders. The 'five service profiles' framing of Video Generation is no longer exhaustive.
fix: Extend the Video Generation bullet to add local ComfyUI as a video backend (#3804).

title: ComfyUI workflow guide not mentioned
reality: #3749 (v2.3.4) added an in-app and GitHub ComfyUI workflow guide covering API-format exports, Marinara placeholders, local and RunPod reference-image inputs, character-specific workflows, LAN setup, VRAM constraints, and troubleshooting.
fix: Point at the new ComfyUI workflow guide from the ComfyUI provider mentions and/or the In-app Documentation viewer bullet (#3749).

title: Noodle refresh missing local time and schedule attachment
reality: #3886 (v2.3.4): every Noodle timeline refresh now includes the user's current local time, plus an optional setting that attaches participating characters' existing generated schedules for the current day.
fix: Add to the Noodle 'Refresh (generation)' paragraph (#3886).

title: Noodle JSON robustness fixes absent
reality: v2.3.4 hardened Noodle against local-model JSON quirks: adjacent JSON objects in timeline collections are all recovered (#3881), and single-object array wrappers for generated profiles no longer cause HTTP 500 on first-time bio generation (#3871).
fix: Add a short robustness note to the Noodle Refresh paragraph (#3881, #3871).

title: Check-in ceiling overrides and removed 50-message summary-tail ceiling absent
reality: #3864 (v2.3.4) added explicit numeric overrides for Conversation chat check-in ceilings and removed the 50-message ceiling from Conversation and Roleplay recent-summary tails, retaining conservative defaults and cost guidance.
fix: Add to the Conversation Mode section (near schedules/check-ins) and the Chat Summary paragraph (#3864).

title: Macro list missing {{group}} and conditional operators
reality: v2.3.4 added the {{group}} prompt macro (lists every other active chat character, including during targeted Roleplay group generation, with the full roster kept available in manual group generation) and added || (OR), && (AND), parentheses, and equality-list shorthand to conditional prompt macros.
fix: Extend the Macros bullet in Special Features.

title: Character/Persona prompt section order not documented
reality: #3817 (v2.3.4): Character and Persona prompt sections now keep editor order across preset markers, fallbacks, agent lore, and Game/scene card contexts: Description, Personality, Backstory, Appearance, Scenario, then Example Dialogue when present.
fix: Note the fixed ordering in Prompt Assembly step 1 (#3817).

title: Downloadable Agents section missing custom GitHub repositories and import hardening
reality: v2.3.4 added disabled-by-default custom GitHub agent repositories to Agents Manager (#3861) and hardened agent imports (#3953: no bundled functions, no self-granted tools, fresh custom identity).
fix: Add two bullets to the 'Downloadable Agents (v2.3)' section covering #3861 and #3953.

title: Scene-video streaming now byte-range
reality: #3811 (v2.3.4): Roleplay and Game scene-video files stream with standard byte-range and HEAD handling instead of synchronously buffering complete MP4 files.
fix: Note byte-range/HEAD streaming on the scene-video endpoints bullet (#3811).

title: Launcher update-check reminder when auto-update disabled
reality: v2.3.4: with automatic updates disabled, launchers still perform a read-only latest-release check and print a console reminder with the installed version and release-page link; --skip-update suppresses all checks for one launch.
fix: Extend the 'New env vars (v2.3, #3730)' bullet.

title: Launchers no longer source .env as Bash
reality: #3810 (v2.3.4): the macOS/Linux and Termux launchers stopped sourcing .env as Bash code; launcher-owned settings use Node's non-evaluating dotenv parser while preserving ambient-environment precedence.
fix: Add a one-line note near the env-var bullets (#3810).

title: SSE resilience across tab-visibility changes
reality: v2.3.4: healthy SSE replies keep streaming after a backgrounded tab becomes visible again, with a grace period before falling back to the persisted full response only if the resumed stream makes no progress.
fix: Add a note to the /api/generate SSE bullet.

title: TTS dialogue pause now whole seconds 1-60
reality: v2.3.4 changed the TTS dialogue pause control to whole seconds from 1 through 60, migrating legacy sub-second and no-pause values to the 1-second minimum (pause feature shipped v2.3.3 #3718).
fix: Update the TTS / voice bullet.

title: Roleplay Stop now cancels server-side immediately
reality: v2.3.4: pressing Stop in Roleplay sends the explicit server cancellation through the authenticated API client (previously CSRF protection could discard it), so generation halts server-side immediately.
fix: Add a one-line note in the Roleplay Mode section or near the /api/generate bullet.
